---
title: "GBIF occurrence filtering — before/after report"
output: pdf_document
params:
  context_file: NULL
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{float}
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
  - \usepackage{longtable}
  - \floatplacement{figure}{H}
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, comment = "")
ctx <- readRDS(params$context_file)
tbl <- function(df, ...) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(cat("_No data._\n\n"))
  print(knitr::kable(df, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "", digits = 2,
                     longtable = nrow(df) > 25, row.names = FALSE, ...))
}
# LaTeX runs in a scratch directory where render_report() copied the figures to figures/
fig <- function(path) {
  if (!is.null(path) && length(path) == 1 && !is.na(path) && file.exists(path)) {
    cat("\n\\begin{figure}[H]\n\\centering\n\\includegraphics[width=\\textwidth,height=0.45\\textheight,keepaspectratio]{",
        paste0("figures/", basename(path)), "}\n\\end{figure}\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
figs <- function(lst) for (p in lst) fig(p)
esc <- function(x) gsub("([_#$%&{}])", "\\\\\\1", x)
S <- ctx$profiles
keep <- c("area_id", "n_records", "n_species", "n_genera", "n_families", "n_records_without_species")
```

# Identification

```{r ident, results="asis"}
env <- ctx$environment
idt <- (data.frame(
  Item = c("Project", "Filtering run", "Generated at", "Tool version", "Git", "R", "Platform", "renv active", "renv.lock md5", "Config file"),
  Value = c(ctx$project, ctx$run_id, ctx$generated_at, ctx$tool_version,
            if (ctx$git$available) paste0(ctx$git$commit, " (", ctx$git$branch,
                                          if (isTRUE(ctx$git$dirty)) ", uncommitted changes" else "", ")") else "not available",
            env$r_version, env$platform, if (env$renv_active) "yes" else "no",
            if (is.na(env$renv_lock_md5)) "no renv.lock" else env$renv_lock_md5, ctx$config_path),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
lin <- ctx$lineage
if (!is.null(lin)) {
  pr <- lin$parent_run
  idt <- rbind(idt, data.frame(
    Item = c("Run type", "Run label", "Parent run"),
    Value = c(lin$run_type, if (is.null(lin$run_label)) "-" else lin$run_label,
              if (is.null(pr)) "-" else paste0(pr$run_id, if (is.null(pr$run_label)) "" else paste0(" (", pr$run_label, ")"))),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}
tbl(idt)
cat("\nThis report describes the **observed availability of GBIF records** and the **effect of the configured filters**. It does not estimate true biodiversity and does not validate the ecological correctness of the raster.\n\n")
cat("This run read existing cache entries only: no GBIF query, download or credentials were used, and the cache files were not modified.\n")
```

Effective configuration:

```{r cfg}
cat(yaml::as.yaml(ctx$config_effective, handlers = list(logical = yaml::verbatim_logical)))
```

# Source cache entries

```{r inputs, results="asis"}
i <- ctx$inputs
tbl(data.frame(area = i$area_id, method = i$method, queried_at = i$queried_at,
               n_raw = i$n_records_loaded, geometry = ifelse(i$geometry_available, "yes", "no")))
cat("**Cache keys and source queries**\n\n")
tbl(data.frame(area = i$area_id, cache_key = i$cache_key))
cat("\n**Source query filters**\n\n")
cat(paste0("- ", esc(i$area_id), ": ", esc(i$query_filters), ifelse(is.na(i$download_doi), "", paste0(" (download DOI: ", esc(i$download_doi), ")"))), sep = "\n")
cat("\n")
cat("**Input file fingerprints (MD5)**\n\n")
tbl(data.frame(area = i$area_id, records_md5 = i$records_md5, meta_md5 = i$meta_md5))
```

# Applied filters

```{r filters, results="asis"}
tbl(ctx$filters_applied)
if (!is.null(ctx$raster)) {
  r <- ctx$raster$raster
  cat("\nThe raster must be EPSG:4326 and is not reprojected. `accepted_values` are raw numeric cell codes matched exactly",
      "(no category labels, ranges or thresholds). Records outside the raster, on NoData cells, or on other values are removed.\n")
  if (isTRUE(r$categorical)) cat("\nThe raster is categorical; codes, not labels, were compared.\n")
  if (r$n_layers > 1) cat("\nThe raster has", r$n_layers, "layers; only the first was used.\n")
}
```

# Record counts by stage

Each stage's denominator is the set of records passed into it (after earlier stages); removals per stage are **not** necessarily unique across criteria.

```{r counts, results="asis"}
st <- ctx$stages
tbl(st[, c("area_id", "stage_order", "filter_id", "n_input", "n_retained", "n_removed")])
cat("**Totals**\n\n")
tot <- data.frame(stage = c("Raw (cache)", "Pre-filter (technically valid)", "Post-filter (retained)"),
                  n_records = c(sum(S$raw$summary$n_records), sum(S$pre_filter$summary$n_records), sum(S$post_filter$summary$n_records)))
tbl(tot)
```

# Removals by stage and reason

```{r removed, results="asis"}
tbl(ctx$removed)
```

# Descriptive profiles (same metrics, per area)

Observed distinct taxa are not true richness. Spatial metrics are not computed for the raw profile.

```{r profiles, results="asis"}
cat("## Raw (as stored in the cache)\n\n"); tbl(S$raw$summary[, c(keep, "year_min", "year_max")])
cat("\n\n## Pre-filter (technically valid records)\n\n"); tbl(S$pre_filter$summary[, c(keep, "year_min", "year_max")])
cat("\n\n## Post-filter\n\n"); tbl(S$post_filter$summary[, c(keep, "year_min", "year_max")])
cat("\n\n## Spatial coverage (pre-filter vs post-filter)\n\n")
sp <- c("area_id", "area_km2", "n_records", "records_per_km2", "coverage_pct", "top10pct_cells_share_pct")
tbl(cbind(stage = "pre-filter", S$pre_filter$summary[, sp])); cat("\n\n")
tbl(cbind(stage = "post-filter", S$post_filter$summary[, sp]))
cat("\n\n## Temporal coverage\n\n")
tp <- c("area_id", "year_min", "year_max", "n_years_with_records", "n_records_without_year")
tbl(cbind(stage = "pre-filter", S$pre_filter$summary[, tp])); cat("\n\n")
tbl(cbind(stage = "post-filter", S$post_filter$summary[, tp]))
fig(ctx$figures$profile_comparison)
fig(ctx$figures$year_comparison)
```

# Maps

```{r maps, results="asis"}
for (id in names(ctx$figures$records_before)) {
  fig(ctx$figures$records_before[[id]]); fig(ctx$figures$records_after[[id]])
  fig(ctx$figures$density_before[[id]]); fig(ctx$figures$density_after[[id]])
}
```

# Warnings, timings and limitations

```{r tail, results="asis"}
cat("**Warnings and errors**\n\n")
w <- unique(ctx$warnings)
if (length(w)) cat(paste0("- ", esc(w)), sep = "\n") else cat("_None._\n")
cat("\n\n**Stage timings (seconds)**\n\n")
tbl(data.frame(step = names(ctx$timings), seconds = unlist(ctx$timings)))
cat("\n\n**Limitations**\n\n")
cat(paste0("- ", esc(ctx$limitations)), sep = "\n")
cat("\n\n**Run status**\n\nThis report is produced only when the run reaches the report stage; the final status (`completed` or `failed`) is in `run_status.yaml`.\n")
```
